lines: # CompilerOutputEquivalenceTest compiles it and compares the artifact with the one checked in
# next to it. CompilerFeatureSeparationTest compiles it once with every feature, and then once
# without each feature: the program as it is has to fail at a part that needs the feature, and
# the program without those parts has to compile.
# A part is a block that begins with a comment "#> needs:" and the features it needs, and ends
# with a comment "#<". A block names every feature it needs, and blocks do not nest. The blocks
# at the top each use one feature alone, as far as the feature stands alone; the blocks below
# join the features whose abilities only work together. What stands outside every block, the
# comments, the empty lines and the statement separator, compiles without any feature.
# The flags ROWS = 4 and VERBOSE and the values GAP = DATA:3 and SPAN = (SIZE * 2) are set by
# the configuration the tests compile with. Without .ORG the code runs along row 0; the blocks
# that move the cursor send it to rows of their own, and the molecules are placed from column
# 600 on, so that leaving a block out moves nothing onto another cell.
.PROC TAKES_ALL REF R VAL V LREF L LVAL LV
.IMPORT "lib/module.evo" AS SUPPLY USING MODULE HELPER AS HELP VALUE COUNT DATA:2
.PROC WORK REF R VAL V LREF L LVAL LV
CALL WORK REF %DR0 VAL DATA:1 LREF %LR0 LVAL %LR1
CALL WORK REF %DR0 VAL %DR1 LREF %LR0 LVAL %LR1
CALL WORK REF %DR0 VAL DATA:1 LREF %LR0 LVAL FIRST
CALL WORK REF %DR0 VAL LIMIT LREF %LR0 LVAL %LR1
#> needs: importdir, ctx, proc, instruction, label
CALL HELPER.CLAMP REF %DR0 VAL DATA:0 DATA:5
#> needs: importdir, ctx, control, instruction, label
#> needs: importdir, ctx, expression, constdir, place
.IMPORT "lib/positions.evo" AS SPOTS USING VALUE CORNER POSITION(640|20) VALUE WIDTH (SIZE + 1)
#> needs: importdir, ctx, expression, constdir, place, label, org, instruction
# A module without requirements, which the main program imports and hands to another module. It
# includes the file the main program includes too, so that one file is included in two places.
#> needs: importdir, ctx, proc, instruction, label
EXPORT .PROC CLAMP REF VALUE VAL MIN MAX
# A file the main program includes with .SOURCE: its names are the main program's.
# A module with every kind of requirement, an import it hands a module to and exports again,
# and an exported label, procedure, constant and control block for the main program.
EXPORT .IMPORT "lib/inner.evo" AS INNER USING MODULE HELP AS HELP VALUE CEIL COUNT
#> needs: importdir, ctx, proc, instruction, label
#> needs: importdir, ctx, control, instruction, label
# A module that requires a module and a value, imported by another module, which hands both on
#> needs: importdir, ctx, proc, instruction, label
CALL HELP.CLAMP REF X VAL DATA:0 CEIL
# A file the main program includes with .SOURCE: its names are the main program's.
# A module that is handed a position and a computation: it places molecules beside the
# position, over a range computed from it, and continues its code at the position, wherever it
